THE CITY · Mixed city of 100: town hall
The same mix with a town hall. On day 17 the town passes relief, five food a day from the city store to anyone with none, paid for mostly by Qwen's taxes. All 100 founders live to day 1,000.
100 founders · 1000 days · with a town hall · seed 1 · qwen
